rag.text:
Test: TC-1068 — Box Module - Board - Basic operations - Displaying tasks warnings
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-34 Box Module - Board - Basic operations
Labels: Sanity, can_be_automated, teamsmile

Steps:
1. Navigate to Board module of boxName.
   Data: boxName: TC-1068 Box Module - Board - Basic operations - Displaying tasks warnings
   Expected: Board module is loaded.
2. Click on the View icon and select Task warnings from the dropdown list.
   Expected: Task warnings are displayed as yelLow exclamation marks on the Lower left corner of the task cards. Task cards have yelLow frame, too.
3. Click on the task warning on the task card of issueName.
   Data: issueName: TC-1068 Task 1
   Expected: There is a message in the dialog:

* The dates of this task don't fall within Program Increment 1.

Two buttons are displayed beLow:

* Change task dates
* Cancel
4. Click on the task warning on the task card of issueName.
   Data: issueName: TC-1068 Task 2
   Expected: There is a message in the dialog:

* The dates of this task don't fall within Program Increment 2. Change them to match this timebox or move the task to Program Increment 1.

Three buttons are displayed beLow:

* Change task dates
* Move the task
* Cancel
5. Hover over the task warning on the task card of issueName.
   Data: issueName: TC-1068 Task 3
   Expected: There is a message in the tooltip displayed:
- Task warning. Click to solve the problem.
6. Click on the task warning on the task card of issueName.
   Data: issueName: TC-1068 Task 3
   Expected: There is a message in the dialog:

The assignee of this task does not belong to Team Alpha. Change the assignee manually, or add this assignee as a team member of Team Alpha.

Two buttons are displayed beLow:

* Go to Teams
* Cancel
7. Click on Go to teams button.
   Expected: Teams module is displayed.
8. Allocate new teamName with teamCode.
   Data: teamName: Team Beta
teamCode: TB
   Expected: Team is created correctly.
9. Assignee userName to teamName.
   Data: userName: Admin
teamName: Team Alpha
   Expected: Admin is user in Team Alpha
10. Navigate to Board module of boxName.
   Data: boxName: TC-1068 Box Module - Board - Basic operations - Displaying tasks warnings
   Expected: Board module is loaded.
11. Move task card of issueName from Team Alpha to Team Beta
   Data: issueName: TC-1068 Task 3
   Expected: Task card is in Team Beta in Program Increment 1 subbox.
Task warning appeared.
12. Click on the task warning on the task card of issueName.
   Data: issueName: TC-1068 Task 3
   Expected: There is a message in the dialog:
The assignee of this task does not belong to Team Beta. Change the assignee manually, or plan this task for one of the teams that the assignee belongs to:

BeLow there is a single select field with Select team placeholder and two buttons:
- Plan for another team (greyed out)
- Cancel
